content:
sarah_pm: Quick sync — I uploaded a lightweight roadmap canvas for tenant isolation + geo-routing: https://notion.redwood/roadmap/tenant-isolation-canvas
sarah_pm: We need to pick the top 3 initiatives to drive next 3 quarters based on recent customer asks (data residency, regional latency guarantees, isolation during surges).
diego_eng: +1. propose framing by launch gate: policy engine -> routing fabric -> migration tooling. keeps scope incremental.
alex: For policy engine we should include: per-tenant rules, emergency quarantine API, and rate limit isolation. otherwise ops will be firefighting.
maya: From customer calls, priority order looks like: 1) EU/data residency controls, 2) region affinity (p95 < 150ms), 3) tenant-level burst isolation (no noisy neighbor).
jeremy: Ops note: cross-region failover will spike egress and affect cost. need a cost-delta analysis before committing to GA.
sarah_pm: Draft acceptance criteria (first pass):
- policy rules enforceable per-tenant in prod (no code changes to service owners)
- canary rollout to 5 pilot tenants with automated rollback
- telemetry: token-level latency by region, % of traffic routed off-peak vs peak
- cost delta documented and <= 20% for Reserved/Dedicated tier (otherwise optional opt-in)
sarah_pm: Proposed gating checklist:
```
[gates]
- architecture signoff (eng + security)
- infra budget + capacity reservation approved
- 2 paying customers committed to pilot
- runbook + rollback tested in staging
```
ops-bot: pipeline template created: /pipelines/tenant-routing-canary (CI/CD infra team)
diego_eng: dev question: do we support per-tenant custom model variants per region at launch? big complexity on model catalog.
alex: i'd avoid freeform variants for launch. support 'routing profiles' mapped to pre-approved model variants only. reduces surface area.
maya: timeline suggestion: Q2: design + 1 pilot, Q3: pilot expansion (10 tenants), Q4: GA for hosted API customers and opt-in for Dedicated.
jeremy: immediate actions:
- diego: mock policy engine API and sample config by Fri EOD
- maya: collect top 5 customer P0 asks and legal/data residency requirements
- alex: cost model estimate (bandwidth + region infra) with eng-infra
sarah_pm: I'll own scheduling a 30m decision sync Thurs 10am PT. @diego_eng @maya @alex please RSVP :calendar_with_t..
alex: RSVP'd :thumbsup:
maya: added :+1:
diego_eng: on it :muscle:
sarah_pm: thanks — i'll update the Notion canvas with the checklist and action owners after the sync.
